image_description: A close-up shot of a decorative ceramic teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup features a white base with intricate red and black floral/botanical patterns and a gold rim. A C-shaped handle is visible on the left side. The interior appears to be a solid reddish-brown color. A silver spoon rests on the right side of the saucer. The background is blurred, showing hints of orange/red objects.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup and not a bowl or vase, and to verify the material appearance (ceramic).
To rigorously check the connection point between the handle and the cup body for any fusion artifacts or structural discontinuities.
To verify the physical contact shadow and depth relationship between the cup bottom and the saucer surface.
To inspect the floral pattern for AI-specific distortions, such as melting lines or inconsistent brushwork.

focus_areas: Contact shadow between cup and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle attachment points. AI often fails to cleanly separate the handle from the body or creates 'floating' handles. Also, verify if the floral pattern distorts logically around the curvature of the cup or if it looks like a flat sticker applied incorrectly.
